envelope.description: Integrate source-light preparation through the production lifecycle

body.title: Integrate source-light preparation through the production lifecycle
body.summary: Wire source-light packet preparation, staged construction/source adapters, isolated workers, progress, cancellation, recovery, publication, approval and cleanup through actual code-review production routes while retaining latest-document design review.
acceptanceChecks: Every code-review route uses locators, transient selected blocks and baseline workspace paths without an eager aggregate source-view fallback; design routes continue latest-document capture.
Checkpoint/resume, progress, cancellation, permanent CR publication and approval cleanup preserve exact scope, history and ownership across crashes and concurrent sessions.
Complete test details and mandatory coverage assessment reach the reviewer; execution remains optional, and no module is skipped because of size or preparation mode.

tests.name: Production source-light lifecycle matrix for CodePreparation, StagedPacketConstruction, StagedPacketSources, workers, routes, checkpoint/recovery/progress/cancel/publication/approval/cleanup, mandatory coverage, and unchanged latest-document design review.
